hypothesis: A larger bounded swing-foot forward task-space reach may improve weak or sideways foot contacts without sacrificing clean contact and balance.

development_courses.reason: good straight foot kick, retention control

shared_setup: One G1 and ball per process; frozen SONIC and actor gate, swing-side revalidation true, lateral cap 0.15 m, no support-knee action.
measure: Clean foot-only first contact; 60-frame dx, |dy|/max(dx,0.01); final maximum lateral excursion and pelvis minimum.
diagnostic_gate: No clean-contact loss or pelvis below 0.65 m on any of four; at least two of the three poor courses improve 60-frame forward displacement by 0.25 m and decrease lateral/forward ratio; retention control remains dx>=1 m, ratio<=0.3 and no >4 m lateral out-of-play. Otherwise reject 0.16 m.
